title: Who Is Actually Paying for the AI Boom?
_: Visuals are cued by PHRASE, not timestamp. The narration is 5,400 characters and will be regenerated more than once; phrases survive that, timestamps don't.

rights.speaker: various
rights.note: Short excerpts as evidence for claims the narration makes. Primary sources preferred. Bloomberg Originals and Hank Green are RESEARCH ONLY, never footage.

chapters.cue: Which brings us to the number
chapters.title: What the filings say

_coldOpenDropped: A 3-clip broadcaster montage ($10B/$90B/a trillion) was built and cut. Dropped on the channel owner's call: the CNA chyron read 'CHINA'S AI IPO WAVE' which is off-thesis (L13), and the BBC ident is roughly a fifth of frame on a monetised video. Rebuilding it from primary sources stalls because the only primary voice available is Oracle's $638B line, which is Ch4's payoff and would be spent in the first ten seconds. The retention question it was meant to test is still open.
_broll: Reviewed on a contact sheet at 1s AND 4s before selection (F6, F29). 7 of 28 rejected: search drift (a ski gondola from 'fiber optic cable', a quarry from 'data center construction'), an unusable blurred frame, a stock-photo man celebrating at a laptop (wrong register for this argument), a near-duplicate of racks-blue, wind turbines (reads as a renewables story), and an office block with the Citi logo legible — see F38.
_fillerOrder: Ordered so neighbours differ in texture and scale — two circuit-board macros back to back read as one long shot, which wastes a cut.

sourceAudio.why: L5 — an Oracle executive states the 638 billion figure in their own voice, under our document highlight. Hearing them say it IS the evidence.

L5, and the one source-audio moment in Ch5. The narration concedes the argument, then the person most invested in it says it himself: '...not only substantially less than you thought, and all of it justified.' Cut deliberately to INCLUDE 'justified' — an earlier cut ended on 'and all of it', which drops the word carrying the whole claim.
the prepaid / bring-your-own-hardware figure, said aloud under the quote card

visuals.why: The forum WIDE is the only angle held through this quote and Elon Musk is in it throughout — the script never mentions him, so putting him on screen asserts he is part of this story (L13). The clean Huang single is 80s earlier, so using it here would put visibly mismatched lips under his voice. A pull quote carries his words and his attribution with no sync to get wrong.
